label: Modal existence requirement of one being by another
definition: ModalRequiresExistence p w x y holds exactly when, at every world accessible from w at which x exists, y exists. It is co-presence across accessible worlds only. When y exists at every accessible world it holds for every x, so it records no source, direction of essence-indexed requirement, explanation or causal dependence.
note: Analyst comparison relation for #1595, used to contrast EssenceRequiresExistence with mere modal co-requirement on the same frame. It introduces no new frame or accessibility relation.
